description: Run the checks Xenon runs before installing, without installing: the package rules, what the sandbox will refuse (inline scripts, remote code, hosts) and the Store's review notes.

folder.description: Absolute path of the widget folder (the one holding manifest.json). Its name is the widget id unless `id` is given.

id.description: Widget id: 2 to 41 characters, a-z, 0-9 and dashes.

name: check_widget
